summary: TMD Energy Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, reporting its unaudited interim financial results for the six months ended December 31, 2025. The filing includes financial statements and a press release detailing a 22.5% revenue decline to $247.6M and a net loss of $8.5M, versus a $0.9M profit in the prior period, driven by lower bunkering volume and marine fuel prices. There are no merger, acquisition, restructuring, or special-situation transactions described. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer.
